name: SoduWork
description: The AI-native engine for teams and their agents. Multi-harness, multi-agent, self-hosted.

capability_evidence.multi-agent-orchestration: ide a team workspace and adds what they don't have: issues that flow from request to execution to sign-off, independent AI review, plugin review and distribution, and access control with audit.
capability_evidence.parallel-execution: The requester and the assignee or their agent A request goes to a colleague, their agent does the work, the requester signs off
capability_evidence.skills-plugins: n sets the method, process, rules and what counts as done A review plugin tells the agent which checks to run and what evidence to attach
capability_evidence.agent-runtime: sn't stay in one person's chat history.
capability_evidence.security-isolation: and adds the layer they don't have: one shared issue pool from request to sign-off, acceptance criteria built into every issue, an independent AI review step, plugin review with scoped grants, and an audit trail.
capability_evidence.self-hosted: Runners and skills are not a general-purpose sandbox: actual isolation depends on the harness and your environment.
capability_evidence.team-collaboration: task and save it as a plugin.
capability_evidence.gui-desktop: heck that the corresponding tool is installed and on PATH, then reopen Command Prompt.
